g1-implement.title: Transactional binding store: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.md from this frozen gate and dispatch one implementer. Require test-led red/green with a real multiprocessing spawn test through production handle_post_tool_use and the real registry path, a deterministic spawned SessionStart-versus-claim race, deterministic unlocked mutation control, identity parity, contained checklist claim validation including symlink escape and validation/open races, recorded release compatibility, safe-reap policy, end-to-end retained-active Stop routing, all three transactional writers, and bounded fail-open advisory locking. Wait for the durable IMPLEMENTER_RESULT and attach exactly one implementer-result with status=complete, red_green=production-spawn, mutation_control=discriminating, mixed_writer=sessionstart-claim, and blast_radius=4-files.

preconditions.statement: execution context loaded and frozen gate confirmed

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT proves production-spawn red/green, discriminating mutation control, mixed-writer coverage, and the exact four-file blast radius

constraints: Allowed production files: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py.
Allowed test files: tests/test_spine_rail.py and tests/test_gauge_writer.py.
Never reap a readable active lease by age; no lifecycle, journal, child, actor/PID, durable-root, or historical-backfill changes.
Use one stable sibling lock file that is never replaced; hold it from before registry load through reap, mutation, temp close/flush, replacement, and cleanup.

Use stdlib-only portable advisory locks with crash release, bounded acquisition, and unique same-directory temp replacement. POSIX locks the stable handle with flock; Windows initializes one byte, seeks to byte zero, locks/unlocks that byte with msvcrt, closes the temp before replace, and fails open on adapter or filesystem errors.
If the production spawn topology cannot show an unlocked lost update, return an honest scoped null; do not manufacture proof.

g1-review.title: Transactional binding store: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill REVIEWER_HANDOFF.md from the frozen gate and fresh implementer evidence. Dispatch an independent reviewer with no authoring context to verify intent, diff, real spawn discrimination, mixed-writer concurrency, mutation control, stable-lock identity, portable adapter failures, exact safe-reap semantics, retained-active Stop routing, identity parity, claim/release compatibility, four-file scope, and non-Windows tests. Wait for and attach exactly one review-result verdict=APPROVE.

postconditions.statement: independent REVIEW_RESULT approves the complete frozen proof contract

constraints: Reviewer must be independent of implementation and must not mutate production or engine state.

g1-integrate.title: Transactional binding store: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Accept only REVIEW_RESULT verdict APPROVE. Re-run focused and full non-Windows verification yourself, enumerate the exact four-file blast radius, and verify fresh production-spawn red/green, mutation-control, mixed-writer, adapter-failure, and Stop-retention evidence. Attach exactly one verification-result with red_green=verified, mutation_control=verified, mixed_writer=verified, stop_retention=verified, and blast_radius=4-files. Record Windows-specific risk separately. Flag out-of-scope findings for triage and advance only when every condition passes.
